Important: This page provides general visa information and procedural guidance only. Arcadia does not provide visa application or issuance services. Our services cover tour programmes, bookings and local transport. View tour programmes.

In a historic step that redraws the tourism map between the Gulf and Russia, the Russian government has introduced visa-free entry for Saudi citizens from 11 May 2026. This decision opens a new gateway for millions of Gulf travellers to discover Russia’s tourist treasures, with no need to wait for a visa or a consular appointment.

Gulf countries covered by visa-free entry

Citizens of all six Gulf states currently enter Russia visa-free. Check the entry rules for your nationality with your airline before booking:

  • Saudi Arabia: visa-free from 11 May 2026
  • United Arab Emirates: already visa-free
  • Qatar: already visa-free
  • Kuwait: visa-free
  • Bahrain: visa-free
  • Oman: already visa-free

When does it take effect?

The decision officially took effect on 11 May 2026, allowing the Gulf citizens it covers to enter through all of Russia’s international border crossings – air, land and sea – without obtaining a visa in advance.

Permitted length of stay

The permitted length of stay depends on each country’s agreement with Russia; for Saudi citizens it is up to 90 days per calendar year. In every case it is ample for a holiday.

Documents required for entry

Although the visa requirement has been lifted, a few basic documents are still needed at the border:

  1. A valid passport — valid for at least 6 months from the date of entry
  2. A return ticket — or any ticket proving departure from Russia
  3. A confirmed accommodation booking

Why is this a golden opportunity not to be missed?

Russia is an exceptional destination that combines historical grandeur, natural splendour and a rich culture. With the visa barrier removed, you can now:

  • Visit Red Square and the Kremlin in the heart of Moscow
  • Marvel at the golden Winter Palace in St Petersburg
  • Shop in the largest European shopping centres
  • Try Russian cuisine at its most authentic in the best restaurants
  • Enjoythe enchanting snowy atmosphere in winter
  • Discover the spiritual side of ancient churches and monasteries
